question: g3_checkout_request
answer:
Created [src/util/checkoutRequest.mjs](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g3_checkout_request/okf/codex/3/src/util/checkoutRequest.mjs) — an import-free ES module exporting `buildCheckoutRequest`, which returns `{method: 'POST', path: 'cart/<cartCode>/checkout', body}`. Verified it runs and produces the right shape with node.

The body maps your inputs to the backend order-request class field names (`PersistableOrder`/`PersistableAnonymousOrder` in `com.salesmanager.shop.model.order.v1`, the payload of `POST /api/v1/cart/{code}/checkout`):

- `shippingOptionId` → `quoteId`
- `currency` → `currency`
- `agreedToTerms` → `termsAccepted`
- `comments` → `orderNote`
- `payment` → `payment: { paymentType: 'CREDITCARD', transactionType: 'CAPTURE', processor: paymentModule, cardToken: paymentToken, amount }`

Note the payment module and token are `processor` and `cardToken` on `PersistablePayment`, not the `paymentModule`/`paymentToken` names Checkout.js currently sends — the backend request class doesn't have fields under those names.

Sources used: `src/pages/other/Checkout.js` (request shape/path), `src/util/constant.js` + `src/util/webService.js` + `env-config.js` (confirming `cart/<code>/checkout` under `/api/v1/`), and the backend guide: `okf/references/backend/routes.md`, `.../com.salesmanager.shop.store.api.v1.order.md`, `.../com.salesmanager.shop.model.order.v1.md`, and `.../com.salesmanager.shop.model.order.transaction.md`. Only the new file was created; nothing else changed.
